title: Integrate incremental SMT

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 incremental-SMT capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current ipfs_datasets source forest already supplies the reusable, versioned IncrementalSmtSession@1 authority and its checked public façade. It binds mutable-context reuse to a deterministic fingerprint, retains named assertion source/obligation references, and emits content-addressed result and replay-manifest identities. The declared-output boundary permits only this receipt, so no duplicate SMT adapter, source mutation, or competing PCSM authority was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The existing implementation and dedicated positive/negative tests are present, but the authoritative sealed environment has neither the z3 Python API required by the sole qualified adapter nor cvc5, and the required pytest command cannot collect because its explicitly configured anyio plugin is absent. In addition, no canonical PCSM current-source-map CID binds supplied source_ref values to exact current file/node/span identities. This receipt records the reusable implementation honestly without claiming an authoritative PCSM solver run or promotion.

evidence_legend.measured: Observed directly from the named current source forest or the authoritative sealed validation environment.

evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

components.role: Provider-neutral, Z3-backed reusable session. It supports declared symbols, named assertions, scoped push/pop, checked assumptions, deterministic cancellation/closed/stale behavior, model validation, and independently rechecked UNSAT cores. It is a cache/replay optimization and never a new proof authority.
Checked public façade that rejects an interface, fingerprint schema, or required session-method mismatch before returning the reusable session.

determinism_and_binding.profile: IncrementalSmtFingerprint canonicalizes provider/version, logic, translator identity, theory fingerprint, policy/configuration/environment roots, deterministic seed, timeout, memory limit, and schema into a canonical identity digest. NamedSessionAssertion binds a stable assertion ID, source_ref, obligation ID, and structural SMT term. IncrementalSmtResult sorts identity-relevant collections and deliberately excludes process-local solver statistics from receipt_id. snapshot_or_replay_manifest canonically binds fingerprint, declarations, active assertions, frame sizes, transcript, and a manifest CID.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Opening a session never installs a provider; only z3 has a qualified reusable adapter; unsupported or absent providers raise IncrementalSmtUnavailable; get_proof raises rather than presenting solver output as a proof object; and session reuse does not raise evidence or mutation authority.
determinism_and_binding.current_pcsm_execution_binding: unavailable because a canonical PCSM source-map/CID and a usable sealed solver are both absent.

source_inventory.role: Versioned incremental-SMT implementation, deterministic semantic identities, source/obligation binding, typed unavailable dispositions, and replay-manifest CID construction.
Checked public API exposure of IncrementalSmtSession@1 and incremental-smt-session/v1.
Dedicated positive and negative incremental-SMT contract coverage.
Public façade interface/schema, replay-identity, cancellation, and unqualified-provider coverage.

positive_coverage: Named lower/upper assertions prove scoped push/pop behavior and an independently rechecked, sorted UNSAT core.

Assumption checks return validated SAT models, replay manifests bind fingerprint and assertion source_ref values, and semantic receipt identities remain stable despite changed process-local solver statistics.
The public façade returns the declared IncrementalSmtSession@1 interface and incremental-smt-session/v1 fingerprint schema.
negative_coverage: Fingerprint mismatch is typed stale reuse; cancellation and closed sessions are typed rather than silently reused.

cvc5/unqualified providers are typed unavailable; importing the module leaves optional solvers cold; malformed terms, identifiers, unsupported raw terms, duplicate declarations/assertions, and invalid frame operations fail before unsafe state reuse.
The public façade rejects unqualified providers and does not elevate cancellation to authority.
positive_and_negative_test_sources.coverage_limit: The dedicated tests validate reusable SMT-session behavior and public contract enforcement. They do not create a PCSM source-map-bound obligation or turn solver observations into kernel-checked proofs.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It selects and validates an existing current-head authority but does not modify the datasets implementation/tests or create a competing SMT subsystem.
Only z3 has a qualified adapter, and it is absent in the authoritative sealed environment. The available provider-environment solvers do not satisfy the sealed-environment gate.
Incremental solver outcomes, validated models, and independently checked cores are not theorem-prover certificates or mutation authority.
The session accepts caller-supplied source_ref values but cannot establish PCSM current-forest source identity until a separate canonical source-map/CID authority exists.
The required PCSM suite could not collect in the sealed environment and is not dedicated incremental-SMT coverage; it cannot be relabelled as a sealed package validation pass.
No model output is accepted as evidence or mutation authority, and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, automatic source materialization, or promotion is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
